common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You're offline. Anbu needs an internet connection to reply.

welcome.title: A gentle space to talk
welcome.subtitle: Whenever you need someone to listen, Anbu is here - patient, warm and honest. Talk or type in your own language.
welcome.aiNote: Anbu is an AI companion. It is not a person, a doctor or a counsellor.
welcome.privacyNote: You decide what Anbu remembers - and you can change it any time.

auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Please sign in.
auth.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Please request a new one.

errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.RESET_INVALID: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the details and try again.
errors.NETWORK: You seem to be offline. Please check your connection.

language.title: Which language feels most comfortable?
language.body: Anbu will talk with you in this language. You can switch any time - even in the middle of a conversation.

interaction.title: How would you like to talk?
interaction.voiceBody: Tap the microphone and talk. Anbu can reply out loud too.
interaction.textBody: Write whenever it suits you. Quiet and private.
interaction.bothBody: Speak or type - whichever feels right at the moment.
interaction.voiceUnavailable: Voice isn't available in this browser yet. You can still choose it - Anbu will use text until voice works here.

memory.title: Would you like Anbu to remember details from your conversations?
memory.body: This is your choice. You can change it any time in the Privacy Centre.
memory.noneBody: Nothing from your conversations is kept. Every conversation starts fresh and disappears when you leave.
memory.sessionBody: Anbu remembers what you said while you're talking, on this device only. When you end the conversation, it's cleared.
memory.personalBody: Anbu can keep details you approve - like what helps you - so it understands you better next time. You can see, edit or delete them whenever you like.
memory.history: Also keep a history of my conversations
memory.historyHint: So you can read past conversations later. Off unless you turn it on.
memory.providerNote: Whichever you choose, your messages are sent securely to our AI provider to create replies. The Privacy Centre explains this.

style.title: When something is bothering you, what helps most?
style.listenBody: I mostly want to be heard.
style.solutionsBody: I like practical ideas and small next steps.
style.balancedBody: Listen, and suggest things when it would help.

about.title: Before we begin
about.point1: Anbu is an AI companion, not a person. It can misunderstand things or make mistakes.
about.point2: Anbu is not a doctor or counsellor. It can't diagnose anything or replace professional care.
about.point3: In an emergency, call 112. For mental-health support, Tele-MANAS (14416) is free and open 24/7.
about.point4: You're in control: change your language, memory and privacy settings whenever you like.

home.subtitle: Take a quiet moment for yourself. You carry so much.
home.moodQuestion: How is your heart feeling right now?
home.moodHint: No scores or streaks. Just a safe place to notice.
home.presence: Anbu is here whenever you'd like to share.
home.quote1: You don't have to hold everything together every minute. Taking a breath is not falling behind.
home.quote2: Your tiredness is real. Rest is not something you have to earn.
home.quote3: You can care for everyone and still matter yourself.
home.ritualBody: Sip something warm. Even four slow breaths can steady your body.
home.ritualImageAlt: A warm cup of chai on a linen cloth in soft morning light

chat.endBodyNone: Nothing from this conversation will be kept.
chat.endBodySession: This conversation will be cleared from this device.
chat.endBodyHistory: This conversation stays in your history until you delete it.
chat.placeholder: Speak or type your thoughts freely…
chat.correcting: Correcting your last message - edit it and send.
chat.emptyBody: Say or write anything, big or small. There's no right way to start.
chat.privacyNone: No memory · nothing is kept after you leave
chat.privacySession: Session only · kept on this device until you end
chat.privacyPersonal: Personal memory · only what you approve is saved
chat.privacyHistory: Personal memory · this conversation is saved to your history
chat.mockBanner: Development mock mode: replies are placeholders, not a real AI. Add an AI key on the server for real conversations.
chat.offline: You're offline. Anbu will be able to reply when you're connected again.

errors.AI_BUSY: Anbu is very busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.AI_NETWORK: Anbu couldn't reach its AI service. Please try again.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Anbu's AI service isn't available right now. Please try again later.
errors.AI_REFUSAL: Anbu couldn't continue that reply. Could you put it another way?
errors.AI_ERROR: Something went wrong while Anbu was replying.
errors.NETWORK: The connection was lost. Check your internet and try again.
errors.CHAT_BUSY: Anbu is still answering your previous message.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You're sending messages very quickly. Please wait a moment.

chat.thoughtIdleBody: Whenever you feel ready to share, tap the button below. There is no rush, no pressure.
chat.sanctuaryLine: A quiet sanctuary to unburden your heart
chat.suggest2: How do I express this gently?
chat.greeting: Hi {{name}}, I'm here with you. How are you feeling today?
chat.startHint: Tap once to begin. After that, just talk. Anbu listens again after every reply.
chat.liveHint: Just talk naturally. Tap the button whenever you want to pause.
chat.livePaused: It went quiet, so Anbu stopped listening for now. Continue whenever you are ready.

voice.noApi: Speaking to Anbu isn't supported in this browser. You can type instead - Chrome and Edge support voice input.
voice.languageRejected: Speech recognition for {{lang}} isn't available on this device. You can still type in {{lang}}.
voice.noVoice: This device has no {{lang}} voice, so replies will be shown as text. You may be able to add one in your device's text-to-speech settings.
voice.reviewHint: Check what Anbu heard, correct anything, then send.
voice.providerNote: In Chrome and Edge, speech is turned into text by the browser's online speech service.

errors.not-allowed: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, or type instead.
errors.no-speech: I didn't catch anything. Tap the microphone and try again.
errors.network: Voice input needs an internet connection. Please try again, or type.
errors.audio-capture: No microphone was found on this device.
errors.language-not-supported: Speech recognition doesn't support this language here. Please type instead.
errors.unavailable: Voice input isn't available in this browser.
errors.unknown: Voice input stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.

safety.title: You don't have to face this alone
safety.titleUrgent: Please reach out for help now
safety.body: If you're in danger or might act on these thoughts, please call now. These services are free.
safety.privacyTip: If someone might look at your phone, ending this conversation clears it from this screen.

telemanas.name: Tele-MANAS (14416)
telemanas.note: Free mental-health support, 24/7, in many Indian languages

women_helpline.name: Women Helpline (181)
women_helpline.note: For women facing violence or abuse, 24/7

reflect.title: Thank you for talking today
reflect.body: Would you like to do anything with this conversation? Everything here is optional.
reflect.nextChoose: Pick one if it feels right - or none at all.
reflect.saveNone: Nothing stood out to save - and that's fine.
reflect.saveSensitive: This seems personal. Save it only if you're comfortable.
reflect.saveDone: Saved. You can view or change memories in the Privacy Centre.
reflect.saveDisabled: Memory is off in your privacy settings, so nothing from this conversation will be saved.
reflect.ownLabel: Or write something you'd like Anbu to remember
reflect.ownPlaceholder: For example: a short walk helps me feel better
reflect.mockNote: Mock mode: these are placeholders, not real AI output.

settings.title: Settings
settings.codeMixingHint: Like Tanglish or Hinglish - Anbu may use the English words you use.
settings.voiceReview: Let me check what was heard before sending
settings.voiceReviewHint: Helpful if speech recognition often mishears you.
settings.voiceTestPhrase: Hello, I'm Anbu. I'm here to listen.
settings.captions: Show live captions while I speak
settings.dailyPrompt: Show a gentle reflection card on the home screen
settings.dailyPromptHint: Anbu never sends reminders or makes you feel you must check in.
settings.name: Name
settings.passwordNote: To change your password, sign out and choose “Forgot your password?”.
settings.showTimingHint: Shows how long each reply took, measured on this device.
settings.voiceGenderHint: Used for Anbu's natural voice and, where available, this device's own voice.

privacy.title: Peace & Privacy
privacy.intro: You are always in control of what stays and what fades away. Here is exactly what happens with your information.
privacy.historyToggle: Keep a history of my conversations
privacy.historyDeleteAllConfirm: Delete all saved conversations? This can't be undone.
privacy.memoriesOff: Personal memory is off, so no memories are saved.
privacy.confirmBody: This change will permanently delete {{conversations}} saved conversation(s) and {{memories}} memory(ies).
privacy.analyticsHint: Anbu doesn't collect analytics today. If it ever does, it will only be with this switched on - and never what you say.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. Everything will be deleted straight away.
privacy.stored: Your account (name, email and a secure hash of your password) and your settings. Only with Personal memory: the memories you approve and, if you turn it on, your conversation history.
privacy.providers: To create replies, your messages are sent over an encrypted connection to our AI provider, {{provider}}. Voice input in Chrome and Edge is handled by the browser's speech service. These providers have their own data policies; we send only what's needed.
privacy.never: We don't sell your data or show ads, and we don't write your conversations into our server logs.
privacy.limits: No online service can promise perfect privacy. If you share a device, others may be able to open this app - use a screen lock and sign out on shared devices.
privacy.eraseNote: You can erase any detail at any time. Once erased, Anbu won't bring it up again.
privacy.promiseQuote: What you share here is yours — to keep, to change, or to let go.

memories.title: Saved memories
memories.intro: Things you've allowed Anbu to remember. Anbu only uses the ones that are switched on.
memories.empty: No memories yet. Add one below, or save some after a conversation.
memories.addPlaceholder: Something that would help Anbu understand you
memories.interpretation: Anbu's understanding - may not be exact
memories.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all saved memories? This can't be undone.
memories.blocked: Personal memory is off. Turn it on in the Privacy Centre to save memories.

history.title: Conversation history
history.disabled: History is off. You can turn it on in the Privacy Centre.
history.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This can't be undone.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of Anbu is ready.
pwa.offlineReady: Anbu can now open without internet. Replies still need a connection.
